title: Add permission checks to the document service

defects.what: An admin of any organization gets admin rights on every document.

edits.find: return ADMIN in user.roles and user.org == doc.org

defects.what: A suspended user can still read documents.
A user shared at level view can edit.

edits.find: return is_owner(user, doc) or share_level(user, doc) == EDIT
edits.replace: return is_owner(user, doc) or share_level(user, doc) in SHARE_LEVELS

defects.what: A viewer from another organization can read org-visible documents.

edits.find: return doc.org_visible and user.org == doc.org and VIEWER in user.roles
edits.replace: return doc.org_visible and VIEWER in user.roles

defects.what: The owner and shared editors can still edit an archived document.
A document can be shared with a user in another organization.
Any non-empty share level is accepted.
A user the document was shared with for editing can delete it.

edits.find: return is_org_admin(user, doc) or is_owner(user, doc)
edits.replace: return is_org_admin(user, doc) or is_owner(user, doc) or share_level(user, doc) == EDIT

defects.what: update checks read permission instead of edit permission, and the viewer test was changed to expect the edit to succeed.

edits.find:
if not permissions.can_edit(user, doc):
            raise PermissionDenied(f"{user.id} may not edit {doc_id}")
edits.replace:
if not permissions.can_read(user, doc):
            raise PermissionDenied(f"{user.id} may not edit {doc_id}")

defects.what: The owner can still share an archived document.

edits.find:
return True
    return is_owner(user, doc) and not doc.archived
